descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Create, play, and build anything together in VR

PatchWorld is a social creative playground where you can play music, make art, build worlds, games, and interactive experiences directly inside VR.

Jam with friends, explore community creations, attend live events, or invent something entirely new.

**For curious and creative minds of all kinds:** musicians, visual artists, performers, educators, and explorers.

[media]


# Hang out, jam, and explore

- Play and create with others in real-time  
- Explore worlds made by the community  
- Attend live events and performances  
- Share your creations and remix others  

Every world is different, and there’s always something new to discover.

[media]


# Customize everything — even how you move and who you are

Create your own movement systems, or transform your identity with custom avatars, VRM imports, and patchable costumes that react to music


[media]

# Build anything — no coding needed

Use simple visual blocks to create:

- Musical instruments and full music studios  

[media]

- Interactive worlds, games, and playful systems  

[media]

- Physics experiments and real-time audiovisual effects  

[media]


Everything is built live in VR, and everything can be played, modified, and remixed.


# Go further

Bring your ideas to life with AI-generated assets, recording tools, and connections to your real-world creative setup.

**Connect & Support** with our incredible community of Patchers on Discord, check out our Wiki, or explore the app content on our web portal at patchxr.com

Join the most inclusive and creative community in VR !
